9	- renders each page of the scan (`data/scans/<county>.pdf`, already in this worktree; `crossfoot.render` has the pdftoppm wrapper) to an image at most 1600 px wide, WebP or PNG, under `site/data/pages/`.

11

13	- Layout at 1440: top bar 52 px (`Crossfoot` wordmark with the mark, then the descriptor from the copy deck, county tabs at the right when there is more than one county); below it the stage (flexible, at least 760 px) and a panel 420 px wide, 24 px gutter and page padding. Check each text and background pair for 4.5:1 and fix the muted ink first if one fails.
14	- The sheet: the page image in a container with `perspective: 1800px`; the sheet itself transformed `rotateX(34deg) rotateZ(-3deg)`, with `transform-style: preserve-3d`. It is the only white surface and the brightest thing on screen. Depth has to read as a real object, without decoration: a soft contact shadow on the blotter that follows the sheet's outline; the county's other pages lying under it as a stack whose edges show (1 to 2 px offsets per page, at most five drawn); the far edge slightly dimmer than the near one. No gradients on the paper, no glow, no glass.
15	- Marks are one SVG overlay in the image's pixel coordinates, so they tilt with the sheet and stay sharp. Every value that has a box is a transparent, focusable rectangle (hover and focus show a 2 px outline in sheet ink). Selecting one (pointer or Enter) does this, in order (UI-SPEC section 7, T-01 and T-02): the sheet's transform eases so that value sits at the optical centre of the stage (600 ms); a band is drawn along its row from the row's label to the row's printed total (6 px, 35 percent opacity, 350 ms), then one along its column down to the small total; `--data-holds` when that sum holds, `--data-fails` when it fails; a ring closes on the value where they cross (180 ms). A printed total can be selected too, and shows the sums it sits on.
16	- Pointer depth: while the pointer is over the stage the sheet leans toward it by at most 3 degrees on each axis, eased, and returns when it leaves. Off under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and on touch.
17	- Controls at the bottom-left of the stage: the one filled button `Replay the audit` (present and disabled in this task, with the line "Replay comes with the run's events" under it; the next task wires it), then quiet text buttons `Lay flat` / `Tilt sheet`, `Previous page`, `Next page`, and the page number. 18	- The tape (panel, top): a white paper strip, Courier Prime, right-aligned figures. Instant under reduced motion.
19	- Under the tape, a card for the selected value: its label in words (contest, row label as printed on the scan, precinct), the value in large figures, its status in words (`accepted`: "Both printed sums hold."; `cannot_verify`: "A printed sum through this value does not hold. Not verified."), and how it was read (model, tries) in small type.
20	- Under that, a list "Sums that do not hold" built from the checks that fail (rows, not cards: page, contest and row or precinct, computed against printed). It is one tab stop: arrow keys move, Enter selects the first value on that sum and turns the sheet to it. This list is the seam where the findings list goes in the next task.
21	- A footer line from the copy deck (limits and sources, with links to the two public repositories named in ARCHITECTURE.md).
22	- With no input the page opens on page 1 with a value selected whose column sum holds and whose row sum holds, drawn and printed, so the first screen already shows the idea. `?cell=<page>:<block>:<row>:<column>` selects another.
23	- IF a data file fails to load THEN the stage says which file (copy deck, Error) and the rest of the page still renders.
24	- The stage has `role="img"` with a label describing the selected value and its two sums in words; every control is a real button; focus is always visible (2 px outline in `--focus`); nothing is hover-only.

## 0. Brief and context profile

- **One line:** Crossfoot audits published election data against the certified scans.
- **User and moment:** a dataset maintainer or data reporter at a desk, checking one county's published file against its scan; a judge on a laptop with a few minutes.
- **Promise:** "Cross" and "foot" are an accountant's words for adding a table across and down. The first screen shows a row sum and a column sum crossing at one cell.
- **Primary action:** Replay the audit.
- **Hero object:** the scanned canvass sheet.
- **Product moment:** two sums cross at a cell and the tape shows which number is wrong.
- **Demo moment:** the same thing, on a cell where the public file and the scan differ.
- **Differentiator:** nothing on screen is the model's opinion. Each finding shows the printed total that decides it and a crop anyone can check.
- **Artifact:** the corrected file and the findings list with crops.
- **World inventory:** the ruled canvass sheet; the county's certification line; an auditor's red and blue checking pencil; adding-machine tape with its total line; a desk blotter.
- **Moving truth:** none while idle. The replay moves only when started.
- **Judging:** see `.prod-build/contract.md` section 12. No UI prize is listed.
- **Budget:** about four hours of UI work.

| Factor | This product | What it changes |
|---|---|---|
| Task frequency | occasional | guidance on screen, one expressive moment |
| Data density | a sheet of several hundred cells, a short list of findings | the sheet carries the density; the panel stays sparse |
| Stakes | public election data | calm, high contrast, exact wording, no celebration |
| Audience | general, new to the domain | plain words; the arithmetic is shown, not described |
| Use scene | desk, projector, compressed video | dark stage, large figures, nothing hover-only |
| Emotional target | exact | every element is tested against it |
| Personality | an auditor's desk | mechanical motion, hard stops |

## 1. Judge tests

**Five seconds.** A stranger sees a scanned results sheet, two lines crossing at one cell, and beside it "Public file: 0 · Scan: 1" with a sum that does not match. They can say: it checks a public file against the scan and found a wrong number.

**Thirty seconds.** Replay runs one county: cells fill, one fails two sums and is re-read, the county closes, the differing cells appear. The crop and the evidence file are one click away. Run numbers (cells audited, right on first read, after re-reads, cost) come from the run file.

**Demo-critical screen:** one, the audit view. **Three stills:** the crossing on the sheet; the tape beside the two values; the findings list with the run numbers.

## 2. Demo script

0:00 the audit view on a finished run of Panola County, with one finding already drawn on the sheet. 0:05 Replay at a labelled speed. 0:25 pick a second finding; the sheet turns to it. 0:35 open its crop. 0:45 the run numbers and the limits line. Recording mode: `?record=1` (the judge card is hidden, toasts dock under the panel, headings hold at 1.6x zoom).

## 3. Screen inventory

| id | route | why it exists | primary action | states |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | `/` | the audit view: the scan, the sums, the findings, the run numbers | Replay the audit | ideal, loading, error, empty (no disagreements), partial (crops only), first-run (no data built) |

No other screens. No sign-in, no settings, no landing page.

## 4. Flow

S1(finished run) --Replay--> S1(replaying; Pause) --end--> S1(finished) ; S1 --select finding--> S1(sheet turns, sums draw, tape prints) ; S1 --Open crop--> dialog(crop + sums) ; S1 --county tab--> S1(other county).

## 5. The audit view

Grid at 1440: top bar 52px; below it two regions, stage (flex, min 760px) and panel (420px), 24px gutter, 24px page padding. At 1024: panel 360px. Under 900: one column, stage first (56vh, sheet laid flat), panel after, the primary action sticky at the bottom with safe-area padding.

| Element | Tier | Register | Levers (grayscale first) | States | Transition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The sheet (scan page image) with marks drawn on it | primary | expressive | the largest thing on screen; the only white surface; tilted in depth (`perspective: 1800px`, `rotateX(34deg) rotateZ(-3deg)`), soft contact shadow on the blotter; marks are SVG in the image's coordinates | loading: a scan line crosses the sheet while "Loading run…" counts files · error: the sheet area says which file failed · partial: no page image, the crop is shown flat instead | on select, the sheet eases so the cell sits at the optical centre (600ms) |

**First ten seconds with no input:** the page opens on the finished run, the first settled finding selected, its sums already drawn, the tape already printed. Nothing is hidden behind a click.

## 7. Choreography

| id | trigger | from -> to | what moves | pattern | timing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-01 | select a finding | list -> sheet | the sheet turns so the cell is centred; the row line draws, then the column line; the ring closes | draw-on onto its cause | turn 600ms ease-in-out; lines 350ms each; ring 180ms |
| T-02 | T-01 ends | sheet -> tape | the tape prints its lines; the total line lands last | stepped print | 60ms a line, at most 900ms |
| T-03 | Replay | finished -> replaying | recorded events play in order: cells appear, failing sums show red, a re-read cell flips, sums turn blue | in-page replay, labelled "Replay · run of <date>, at <n>x" | 40 events a second by default |
| T-04 | Lay flat | tilted -> flat | the sheet's rotation eases to zero | same thing, different view | 400ms |

Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: no turn, no draw-on, no stepped print; states change with a 150ms fade. Replay still steps through events, with a visible Pause.

## 9. Copy deck

- Top bar: `Crossfoot` · `audits public election data against the certified scans`
- Primary: `Replay the audit` / `Pause replay`
- Controls: `Lay flat` / `Tilt sheet` · `Previous page` · `Next page`
- Finding card labels: `Public file` · `Scan` · `Kind of slip` · `Decided by`
- Kinds: `wrong number` · `wrong column` · `wrong precinct` · `missing row` · `row fails its own total`
- Statuses: `Settled by the printed totals` · `Read from the scan by the agent. A person has not confirmed this yet.` · `No printed total can decide this. Left as published.` · `The document disagrees with itself. Listed for a person.`
- Tape: `adds to` · `printed total` · `matches` · `does not match`
- Buttons on the card: `Open crop` · `Evidence file`
- Run numbers: `cells audited` · `right on first read` · `right after re-reads` · `re-read` · `disagreements` · `settled` · `model cost` · `minutes`
- Replay label: `Replay · run of {date} · {n}x`
- Empty: `No disagreements in this county.`
- Error: `Couldn't load {file}. Reload, or open the repository's runs folder.`
- First-run: `No run has been built into this page yet. Run crossfoot site build.`
- Footer: `These are transcription slips in a volunteer dataset. Each county's certified scan is the source of truth. Sources: the OpenElections sources and data repositories for the 2024 Texas general election.` (with links)
- Judge list: `Judge this in 90 seconds` · `1 Replay the audit` · `2 Pick a finding` · `3 Open its crop and add it up yourself`

## 10. Brand

Mark: on a 48 grid, a horizontal stroke and a vertical stroke crossing, with a ring where they cross; two flat colours (pencil blue, pencil red) on the dark stage, ink on light. Wordmark: `Crossfoot` in Public Sans 800, -0.03em. Favicon: the mark as `favicon.svg`.

## 11. Real-product checks

Value: it shows which cells to fix and why. Clarity: the first screen is a finished run. Trust: every finding shows the printed total and a crop; nothing shows a confidence percentage. Feedback: selection responds in under 100ms. Failure: a missing file names itself and the rest of the page still renders. 10x data: page images are loaded one at a time and the list is virtualised above 200 rows. Maintainability: no dependencies.

## 12. Don'ts

No gradients, glows or glass. No confetti, no sounds. No percentages of confidence. No candidate, party or official mentioned outside the scan's own row labels. No number that is not in the run's files. Nothing that moves without a visible Pause.

## 13. Acceptance

Sprint gates: cut pass; the anti-slop grep; axe with zero violations at 1440; keyboard path through Replay, list and crop; reflow at 320; the first screen measured at 1440x900 and 390x844 with the action and a finding visible and no input.

6-## The idea in one paragraph

8-A scanned table prints its own totals. If every cell is read into a ledger, each value can be tested twice: its
9-row has to add up to the total printed at the end of the row, and its column has to add up to the total printed
10-under the column. One wrong cell fails both sums, and the two failing sums cross at it. Crossfoot reads the scan
11-with a vision model, accepts a value only when both sums hold, re-reads the cells where they do not, and then uses
12-the closed ledger to audit a published file that was copied from the same scan.

40-## Inputs
41-
42-Eight Texas counties from the OpenElections project's 2024 general election benchmark. All eight scans are
43-image-only PDFs (no text layer): Cottle 12 pages, Foard 16, Jones 20, Limestone 42, Lynn 37, Panola 6, San Saba 21,
44-Scurry 38.
45-
46-- Scan: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openelections/openelections-sources-tx/master/2024/general/2024%20<County>%20County%2C%20TX%20precinct-level%20results.pdf`
47-- Published file: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openelections/openelections-data-tx/master/2024/counties/20241105__tx__general__<county>__precinct.csv`
48-  with columns `county, precinct, office, district, party, candidate, votes, absentee, early_voting, election_day`.
49-
50-## Two layouts
51-
52-**Matrix (Panola).** A landscape canvass sheet. The header row lists the precincts as columns and ends in a TOTAL
53-column. Each candidate is a block: a label at the left, three ruled rows (EARLY, ABSENTEE, PRECINCT), a row of
54-small printed totals under the columns, and a grand total under the TOTAL column. In the published file EARLY is
55-`early_voting`, ABSENTEE is `absentee`, PRECINCT is `election_day`, and the small total is `votes`.
56-Checks per block: for each precinct, early + absentee + precinct = the small total; for each row, the precinct cells
57-add to the row's TOTAL; the small totals add to the grand total.
58-
59-**Report (San Saba, Cottle and others).** One precinct per page or section. Each candidate is a row with four
60-numbers: TOTAL, Absentee, Early Voting, Election Day. Checks per row: total = absentee + early + election day.
61-Where the page prints a total for the contest, the candidates' totals have to add to it.
62-
63-`layouts/profile.py` asks the model which layout the first page shows and what the column order is, then reads the
64-first page under that layout and runs the checks. A profile under which more than a third of the sums fail is
65-rejected; the other layout is tried; if neither holds the county is reported as "layout not supported" and left alone.
66-
67-## Reading
68-
69-1. `render.py` renders a page at 200 dpi.
70-2. Matrix: `segment.py` finds the blocks as bands of ink separated by blank bands, and the column lines inside a
71-   block as columns of dark pixels that run the height of the ruled rows. Report: the page is read whole.
72-3. Matrix: each block is cut into column groups no wider than 1,500 px at 300 dpi, one model call per group; report:
73-   one page per call. The answer is strict JSON, validated (right number of columns, integers only), with one repair
74-   request. Every value comes back with the block, row kind and column it belongs to.
75-4. Which model reads a county is decided by measurement, not fixed. A sample of the first page is read with
--
86:- `events(ts, county, kind, payload_json)` for everything the agent did, in order. The results page replays these.
87-- A county is `closed` when every sum holds and the grid has no gap, or every open cell is `cannot_verify`.
88-- Resume: on start, accepted cells are kept and only open ones are worked on.
89-
90-## Checks (`checks.py`, no model, no I/O)
91-
92-Pure functions over the ledger's rows. They return, for each sum, its terms, the printed total, the computed total
93-and pass or fail, and for each failing cell the sums that cross at it. `locate()` returns the cells that sit on a
94-failing row sum and a failing column sum at once. Grid completeness lists every precinct, contest and candidate that
95-is present in one place and absent in another.
96-
97-## The investigation loop (`agent.py`)
98-
99-Every value on a matrix sheet sits on two printed sums. A cell sits on its row and its column. The small total under
100-a column sits on that column and on the grand total (the small totals add to it). A row's printed total sits on its
101-row and on the grand total (the three row totals add to it). So one wrong value makes exactly two sums fail, and they
102-cross at it. `checks.locate()` pairs failing sums that share one value and whose differences agree: that value is the
103-suspect, and the difference says what it would have to be.
104-
105-The loop works the sums that still fail after the first read, and later every disagreement with the published file.
106-For a located suspect it looks at the scan again: a re-read of that one value, cut at 400 dpi or more and enlarged.
107-A value changes only because a re-read of the scan gave the new value; arithmetic says where to look, never what to
108-write. What pairing cannot locate goes to the model, which is shown the failing sums and what has been tried and
109-returns one action as JSON:
110-
111-- `reread {target, dpi, model}`: a single value, a column slice or a row strip
112-- `conclude {item, verdict, reason}`: `document_inconsistent` or `cannot_verify`
113-- `ask_policy {question_id}`: use the stored answer, or the default marked as unconfirmed
114-- `done {item}`
115-
116-Rules that code enforces whatever the model says: at most six actions per item; re-reads climb one step at a time
117-(the county's reader, then `claude-sonnet-4.6`, then `claude-opus-4.6`), a step only after the one below has failed
118-to settle the value; the same target is never re-read twice with the same model and dpi; no value is accepted unless
119-both of its sums hold; a value the scan shows the same way twice while its two sums still fail is
120-`document_inconsistent` (the document disagrees with itself there) and the stored policy answer applies; a correction
121-is written only when the printed totals agree with the new value and disagree with the old one.
122-Every action and its result is an event in the ledger and a span in neatlogs.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from . import checks

LAYOUT = "matrix"
GEO_DPI = 200


def _page_sizes(county, pages, root):
    from .render import page_png
    out = []
    for n in pages:
        try:
            with Image.open(page_png(county, n, GEO_DPI, root)) as im:
                out.append({"number": n, "width": im.width, "height": im.height, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
        except Exception:
            out.append({"number": n, "width": None, "height": None, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
    return out


def write_county(run_dir, county, run_id, led, geo, summary, *, pages=None, data_root=None) -> Path:
    cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
    if pages is None:
        pages = sorted({c["page"] for c in cells})
    box = lambda c: [c[k] for k in ("x0", "y0", "x1", "y1")] if c["x0"] is not None else None
    seen, blocks = set(), []
    for c in cells:
        k = (c["page"], c["block_id"])
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            bb = geo.block_box(*k) if geo else None
            blocks.append({"id": c["block_id"], "page": c["page"], "contest": c["contest"],
                           "candidate": c["candidate"], "box": list(bb) if bb else None})
    chs = [{"kind": ch.kind, "page": ch.page, "block": ch.block_id, "key": ch.key,
            "terms": [[list(k), v] for k, v in ch.terms], "printed": ch.printed, "computed": ch.computed, "ok": ch.ok}
           for ch in checks.all_checks(cells, totals)]
    tbox = lambda t: (lambda b: list(b) if b else None)(
        geo.total_box(t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]) if geo else None)
    d = {"county": county, "run_id": run_id, "layout": LAYOUT,
         "pages": _page_sizes(county, pages, data_root) if pages else [],
         "blocks": blocks,
         "cells": [{"page": c["page"], "block": c["block_id"], "contest": c["contest"], "candidate": c["candidate"],
                    "row_kind": c["row_kind"], "column": c["column"], "value": c["value"],
                    "first_read": c["first_read"], "status": c["status"], "tries": c["tries"], "model": c["model"],
                    "reason": c.get("reason"), "box": box(c)} for c in cells],
         "totals": [{"page": t["page"], "block": t["block_id"], "direction": t["direction"], "key": t["key"],
                     "value": t["value"], "box": tbox(t)} for t in totals],
         "checks": chs,
         "events": [{"ts": e["ts"], "kind": e["kind"], "payload": json.loads(e["payload_json"])}
                    for e in led.events(county)],
         "summary": summary}
    out = Path(run_dir) / county / "county.json"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    return out


"""Page rendering with pdftoppm, and crops with Pillow."""
from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from .sources import DATA, scan_path


class RenderError(Exception):
    pass


def page_png(key: str, page: int, dpi: int = 200, root: Path = DATA) -> Path:
    """Render one page (1-based) of a county's scan to data/pages/<key>/pNN-<dpi>.png; cached."""
    out = root / "pages" / key / f"p{page:02d}-{dpi}.png"
    if out.exists():
        return out
    if shutil.which("pdftoppm") is None:
        raise RenderError("pdftoppm is not installed; install poppler-utils (apt install poppler-utils)")
    pdf = scan_path(key, root)
    if not pdf.exists():
        raise RenderError(f"{pdf} is missing; run `crossfoot fetch --county {key}` first")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    r = subprocess.run(["pdftoppm", "-png", "-r", str(dpi), "-f", str(page), "-l", str(page),
                        "-singlefile", str(pdf), str(out.with_suffix(""))],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0 or not out.exists():
        raise RenderError(f"pdftoppm failed for {pdf} page {page}: {r.stderr.strip()}")
    return out


def crop(png: Path, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], dest: Path) -> Path:
    """Crop (x0, y0, x1, y1) out of an image and save it."""
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with Image.open(png) as im:
        im.crop(box).save(dest)
    return dest

"""Builds the results page's data: `python -m crossfoot.sitebuild --run <run_id>`.

Reads runs/<run_id>/<county>/county.json (fields: see outputs.py) and writes, under site/data/:
  index.json           run, started, ended, counties [{key, name, file, pages}], summary {county: figures the run
                       recorded}, run {model_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, metered_cost_estimate}
  <county>.json        the county, with short keys (below), no indentation
  pages/<county>-pN.webp   each scan page at most 1600 px wide

Short keys in <county>.json
  pages   [{n, img, w, h, sc}]   n page number, img path relative to site/, w and h image pixels,
                                 sc = image pixels per pixel of the run's 200 dpi boxes
  blocks  [{id, p, contest, cand, x}]            x = box in image pixels, or null
  values  [{p, b, r, c, v, s, x, m, n}]          cells and printed totals alike, in this order
            p page, b block, r row kind (cell) or 'col' / 'row' / 'grand' (printed total), c column (cell) or key
            (printed total), v value, s status (cells only), x box in image pixels or null (never a zero box),
            m model and n tries (cells only)
  checks  [{k, p, b, y, ok, pr, co, t}]          k row | col | grand, y key, pr printed, co computed,
            t = indexes into values, in the order the sum is added
  events  [{t, k, p}]                            ts, kind, payload, as recorded
  layout, run, county                            as recorded
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

MAX_WIDTH = 1600
RENDER_DPI = 200


def _scale_box(box, sc):
    """A box in 200 dpi pixels -> image pixels; None stays None, and so does anything that is not four numbers."""
    if not box or len(box) != 4 or any(v is None for v in box):
        return None
    return [round(v * sc, 1) for v in box]


def build_county(raw: dict, sizes: dict, img_path=lambda county, n: f"data/pages/{county}-p{n}.webp") -> dict:
    """The county's JSON for the page. `sizes` maps page number -> (render_w, render_h, img_w, img_h)."""
    county = raw["county"]
    pages, sc_of = [], {}
    for pg in raw["pages"]:
        n = pg["number"]
        if n not in sizes:
            raise ValueError(f"page {n} of {county} has no rendered size")
        rw, rh, iw, ih = sizes[n]
        # the boxes live in the frame of the recorded size when there is one, else of the render
        frame_w = pg.get("width") or rw
        sc = iw / frame_w
        sc_of[n] = sc
        pages.append({"n": n, "img": img_path(county, n), "w": iw, "h": ih, "sc": round(sc, 6)})

    values, index = [], {}

    def add(p, b, r, c, v, box, **extra):
        if (p, b, r, c) in index:
            raise ValueError(f"value {p}:{b}:{r}:{c} appears twice in {county}")
        index[(p, b, r, c)] = len(values)
        d = {"p": p, "b": b, "r": r, "c": c, "v": v, "x": _scale_box(box, sc_of.get(p, 1.0))}
        d.update(extra)
        values.append(d)

    for c in raw["cells"]:
        add(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"], str(c["column"]), c["value"], c.get("box"),
            s=c["status"], m=c.get("model"), n=c.get("tries"))
    for t in raw["totals"]:
        add(t["page"], t["block"], t["direction"], str(t["key"]), t["value"], t.get("box"))

    checks = []
    for ch in raw["checks"]:
        refs = []
        for key, _ in ch["terms"]:
            p, b, r, c = key
            k = (p, b, r, str(c))
            if k not in index:
                raise ValueError(f"check {ch['kind']} {ch['page']}:{ch['block']}:{ch['key']} names a term "
                                 f"{p}:{b}:{r}:{c} that is not a value")
            refs.append(index[k])
        checks.append({"k": ch["kind"], "p": ch["page"], "b": ch["block"], "y": str(ch["key"]), "ok": bool(ch["ok"]),

               "x": _scale_box(b.get("box"), sc_of.get(b["page"], 1.0))} for b in raw["blocks"]]
    return {"county": county, "run": raw["run_id"], "layout": raw["layout"], "pages": pages, "blocks": blocks,
            "values": values, "checks": checks,
            "events": [{"t": e["ts"], "k": e["kind"], "p": e["payload"]} for e in raw["events"]]}


def render_pages(county: str, page_numbers, out_dir: Path, data_root=None, max_width=MAX_WIDTH) -> dict:
    """Renders each page at 200 dpi (cached by crossfoot.render), saves a WebP at most max_width wide."""
    from PIL import Image
    from .render import page_png
    from .sources import DATA
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sizes = {}
    for n in page_numbers:
        with Image.open(page_png(county, n, RENDER_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
            rw, rh = im.size
            iw = min(max_width, rw)
            ih = round(rh * iw / rw)
            im.convert("L").resize((iw, ih), Image.LANCZOS).save(out_dir / f"{county}-p{n}.webp", quality=88, method=6)
        sizes[n] = (rw, rh, iw, ih)
    return sizes


def build(run_id: str, runs_dir="runs", out="site/data", counties=None, data_root=None) -> list[str]:
    run_dir = Path(runs_dir) / run_id
    out = Path(out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    meta = json.loads((run_dir / "run.json").read_text()) if (run_dir / "run.json").exists() else {}
    keys = counties or sorted(p.parent.name for p in run_dir.glob("*/county.json"))
    if not keys:
        raise SystemExit(f"no county.json under {run_dir}")
    index = {"run": run_id, "started": meta.get("started"), "ended": meta.get("ended"), "counties": [], "summary": {},
             "run_totals": {k: meta[k] for k in ("model_calls", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens",
                                                 "metered_cost_estimate") if k in meta}}
    for key in keys:
        raw = json.loads((run_dir / key / "county.json").read_text())
        sizes = render_pages(key, [p["number"] for p in raw["pages"]], out / "pages", data_root)
        d = build_county(raw, sizes)
        (out / f"{key}.json").write_text(json.dumps(d, separators=(",", ":")))
        index["counties"].append({"key": key, "name": key.replace("_", " ").title(), "file": f"data/{key}.json",
                                  "pages": len(d["pages"])})
        index["summary"][key] = raw.get("summary", {})
    (out / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, separators=(",", ":")))
    return keys


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m crossfoot.sitebuild")
    ap.add_argument("--run", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--runs-dir", default="runs")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="site/data")
    ap.add_argument("--county", action="append")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    keys = build(a.run, a.runs_dir, a.out, a.county)
    print(f"wrote {a.out}/index.json and {len(keys)} county file(s): {', '.join(keys)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

 - uv run pytest -q: 49 passed.
 - uv run python -m crossfoot.sitebuild --run 20261011-102700 wrote index.json, panola.json (848 KB) and six WebP pages at 1600 px wide (688 KB).
 - Screenshots in qa/t06a/, all opened and checked: opening, page 3, a failing sum picked from the list, ?flat=1, 390x844, and the first and last precinct column at 2x. Rings and bands sit on their cells.
 - A scripted browser run covered clicking, arrow keys and Enter on the marks, Next page, the list by keyboard, Lay flat, and a 404 on panola.json. The stage names the missing file, the rest of the page renders, and there were no script errors.
 - Text contrast: every text pair is 6.0 or higher, so the muted ink was left as it is.
RULINGS (none changes the brief's text):
 - Value ids are page:block:row:column. Printed totals use row = col / row / grand, as the run's own grand-check terms already do. Cost if wrong: ?cell= links to totals would change.
 - A printed total shows only the sums the data records for it. A row total shows its row sum only, because the run's grand check lists only the small totals.
 - Sheet is 84% of the stage width and zoom on select is 1.2x. At 1.5x and above the sheet filled the stage and hid the stack and edges, so depth did not read. Cost: scan figures are small.
 - Next and Previous page select the first accepted value there whose two sums hold. The brief was silent.
 - The far edge is dimmed with one flat 3.5% strip at 7% black, not a gradient.
 - The stage's role="img" is on the sheet element, with the focusable marks as its sibling in the same 3D pose, so nothing focusable sits inside the img.
 - Page images are 8-bit grey WebP at quality 88.
MEMORY: applied none (docs/memory is empty); new failure worth recording: none
CONCERNS:
 - Axe was not run (no tool offline).
 - 76 cells on page 1 (the Registered voters and Ballots cast blocks) have no box in county.json, so they cannot be selected on the sheet. They appear only in tapes and failing-sum rows. When a failing sum has no boxed term, the list selects its printed total instead. The fix is on the run side, not in this task.
 - At 1440x900 the "Sums that do not hold" list shows about 2 rows before the panel scrolls.
 - Fonts come from Google Fonts at run time. If the host is unreachable, system fallbacks show, and the screenshots may use them.
 - Not screenshotted: 320 and 1024 widths, and the pointer lean (it was never exercised in a pointer test).
